description_sq: Apartament per shitje ne nje nga zonat me te preferuara ne Tirane me akses shume te shpejt si ne Unazen e Madhe ashtu dhe ne Unazen e Vogel.Apartamenti eshte i investuar ne cdo detaj me projekt te detajuar me arkitekt ne menyre qe te shfrytezohet cdo hapesire e detaj. Apartamenti eshte i ri dhe i pabanuar me pare.Mundesohet edhe blerja e dy posteve parkimi me cmim ekstra.
description_en: Apartment for sale in one of the most preferred areas in Tirana with very fast access to both the Big Ring and the Small Ring. The apartment is invested in every detail with a detailed project by an architect in order to use every space and detail. The apartment is new and previously unoccupied. It is also possible to purchase two parking spaces at an extra cost.
